content.title: Exclude inaccessible sitting slots
content.intent: In a slot view with a known accessible control slot, slots of unlinked preceptors and slots restricted to another Abhyasi do not appear.
content.technique_notes: Negative/auth EQP: inaccessible unlinked versus linked but restricted to someone else are equivalent forbidden outcomes swept as parameters. Strength=3 because visibility is access-sensitive; covering_array's unlinked and restricted classes are represented, not a claim of complete 3-wise execution under the ceiling.

inaccessible_classes: slot restricted to another Abhyasi by a linked preceptor
